book.name: 1 Korin
book.title: 1 Korin Polna Mimirini Tombaimoa, Korinnindm Kolvrowolalm Kristusnindm, Noinda Ambo Sahonam Avnam Hev.

content: Lehra kava hellena, os una, ongariskui vina diva hevm ambo. Wo temba snamba yunam sahoklalnonoa, eva nomba vivmoata snamba wevsakoklava, temba puehalnindva Sesoamba tit vrivpa. Mongo Kristusnindrini ombol pelvramnana avakondalmba.

Wo yimba pevmba mendah os wivewol viv i, ov, kava doa kuvhoawol vi monglamba lehra, a? Owai, yeoa honindaoa mindnam loukuk veo. Wo no indhanariniva, temba himba nomba sahonamba venamba, wolaihapulvo hemoa, pevtindiriniminioa.

Kanamba nihva diva yemba wonavmoa, heva os kana nengavnangva ten yeinda luhunv. Wo doa kava lesvhoana indhanarinimba nomba, snamba indkoklava himba nomba temba vevpa. Kava nengawomnav hemba, himba os maim oi, kava di mongawulm wonav yemba.
Henga mongawulm kuso, os pina mendekli Yesusna nihilla. Kava ten yemba wonav kavna nengavnangna, wo yimba si nonapopol avra pivna mendeklina Yesusnana.

Noinda yimba nonamba kusovrava, ambo hemoa Setanm wuleihimnu, Setan daha hukum vevma. Pioa honaoa velohmanara, osm henaoa nihoa wohmueisowa vera, hena meississongolva si Sesoava beswonam omnavav hengava.

Pevmba wivewolalmba yenamba owai, luhunvmoa besalva. Yimba hona moamba pev nonora lovahv, eskand ambo yisva, wo heva os heva hev ambo rotiva tevwol vev? Memba osm, honamba indhanariniva plalva, indhanamba pimba indkumbimba nungeilvpa, indhanakokla.

Noinda yeoa dembhanga viu doaraminioa yisoa, osm yimba si avav nemel rotielm. Wo yimba si nemelnonoa avav yishuimsna. Memba osm, yeoa indkoklamoa wuleihu. Manara, Kristusmba doa wohkihpieinna, os maim oi, sipsipm wuweihiv Pasovatihram. Himba honamba vena, pim kilumbshuapralm pivna sahaposworinim.

Wo doa pioa osangas mumushhoa vruwulanga pivna tihoa, heva os no rotinamba owai, yis kololnamba. No yis kololva, yisva indkoklarini. Heva os pioa hlai rotioa noi yishui. Memba honamba wevsava, pimba si kolvrowol vevav, und besalnam alm, eva osoa moanonoalm eisholm.
Pol Unna, Yeoa Kristusnindoa Ehalla Viu Nonapenamoa, Temba Indkoklava Vewuvpa.
Kava ambo ambara yemba novol vepiprinna kavna doara tombaira, osva yeoa ehalla viu nonapenamoa, nom ten ongariskui viwul vevm.

Heva os kava osmba ovnamoa, yeoa nongaliheu indhanakoklamoa hona pethanindmoa. Yimba osva honamba pethava wohwuleihinvav, wo kava honamba ovmoa. Indhanamba pethanindva wohviv ongariskuiva, muemb nelm, yukovm, tihsongom sembayangna okolawol viv.

Kava novol vepiprinv hona tombaiva, yem ishunilm, osm yeoa ehalla viu nonapenamoa. Himba nomba hevmba osva ovrava, kava Kristustindirini lohv, heva os himba ongariskuiva vevna, hevmangas nengvra, tihsongom okolawol vevra sembayangna, moangakalamoa owalmba ishunvra, daipw nevra, owalm viliengalvra. Manam yimba hlavra innemba snamongova mongawulmba.

Memba kana andrava owai, lesvhoawolalmba, nomba temba himba almba owai vevpa Kristusnindilmba. Sesoa hev si lesvhoawol vevav hemba. Heva os yeoa lesvhoawol vivm indhanamoa nomoa, himba temba avpa Kristusnindva. Sesoana doaramini tombaimorava os novol velohv,

content.text: Yeoa indhanakoklamoa engalwul veo pevnaminioa. Lo 13:5 eva 22:21-24
